_comment: Regex masks the Stubsmith API accepts and rejects on save. For accepted patterns, expected[i] is Python's re.sub(pattern, '<m>', inputs[i]), with a flags value containing 'i' applied as a leading (?i), as the Python SDK does. Expected values come from Python; never edit them by hand. The Node SDK must produce the same strings. For rejected patterns, problem is a fragment of the API's error message.
